subject: POC Trial environment options - hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acmeai.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@acmeai.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Trial environment options - hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC

Thanks for the call this morning - great to meet the Acme AI team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have everything in one place.

Call recap
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood inference for Acme's customer support summarization pipeline.
- Success criteria (what Acme told us):
  - P95 inference latency < 200ms for the 512-token prompt distribution in peak workload (projected 250 concurrent requests during peak test).
  - Token throughput and cost per 1M tokens within budget target (TBD; Samir to confirm target $/1M).
  - Functional: identical output quality (ROUGE/EM-like checks) vs current baseline on a 200-sample eval set.
  - Integration: ability to call Redwood API from Acme staging environment and validate audit/logging.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): agree on success criteria, pick POC environment, exchange infra/contact details.
- Week 1-2: Run a 2-week trial with sample traffic (sandbox). Baseline tests and quality evals run by Acme + Redwood.
- Post-trial: review results and decide rollout path (dedicated vs private VPC).

Ownership
- Acme: Samir Shah (PM) and Priya Kapoor (Infra)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (seller, POC lead) and Dev Patel (technical lead)

Environment options (summary)
- Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood hosted API with per-request logging. Minimal setup; good for initial functional and latency testing.
- Dedicated sandbox (recommended intermediate): Reserved small GPU pool for Acme for predictable throughput and isolated workloads; quick to provision (3-5 business days) and lets you test cost/throughput at scale.
- VPC/private deployment (full isolation): Customer-managed VPC or on-prem; required for strict data residency/compliance. Provisioning + security review typically 2-3 weeks.

Attachments: attached POV plan and trial checklist (redwood-poc-plan.pdf, poc-trial-checklist.xlsx).

Next steps for Acme (please confirm):
1) Confirm success criteria above and provide cost target if you have one.
2) Let us know preferred trial environment (hosted -> sandbox -> VPC) - if no preference, we suggest starting hosted and then standing up a dedicated sandbox for scale testing.
3) If you want a VPC trial, please share the AWS account ID & point of contact for the security review.
4) Pick a kickoff slot next week for tech kickoff (30-45m).

Happy to jump on another call to walk through the checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa

Samir - thanks for the quick reply and the cost target. Short answers up front:
- Hosted: no customer model weights or logs are stored outside our control plane for the trial; request logs and audit events are available and can be exported to your SIEM. If you need guaranteed network egress isolation, choose VPC.
- VPC trial: it does add ~1-2 weeks for security review and networking config; we can run a partial baseline test on hosted while the VPC review is in flight so you don't lose time.

Proposed pragmatic approach (recommended):
1) Start the functional latency and quality tests immediately on Hosted - quickest path to validate model output and p95 latency.
2) Parallel: kick off VPC security review with Priya - Redwood will prepare the security packet and a short runbook.
3) If throughput/cost testing is needed at scale, provision a dedicated sandbox (3-5 business days) once Hosted functional tests pass.

Proposed schedule
- Mon 29 Mar: 30m technical kickoff (Dev + Priya + Samir)
- Tue 30 Mar to Mon 12 Apr: 2-week hosted evaluation window (we'll provide a test harness + traffic replay tool)
- Week of Apr 5: if needed, dedicated sandbox spin-up for scale tests

Can you confirm: Samir/Priya - OK to proceed with hosted first and start VPC review in parallel? If yes, Priya can share an AWS account ID and preferred contact for the security questionnaire.

I've attached an updated POA and the trial checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Priya / Samir - technical notes from my side and what I'll need to kick off.

If you go hosted-first (recommended):
- We'll provide API keys scoped to the trial account and a traffic replay harness (Docker image) to push up to your expected workload.
- We'll run smoke tests and provide a short runbook for capturing audit logs to your SIEM (via S3 export or syslog).

If you opt for VPC trial later:
- Required items from Acme: AWS account ID, VPC CIDR, list of allowed egress endpoints, and an IAM role ARN we can assume for provisioning.
- We'll provide a CloudFormation / Terraform module to stand up the minimal infra. Security review checklist attached in the Drive link.

Proposed technical kickoff agenda (30m)
- Intro & contacts (5m)
